subject: Agent control-link disconnects during private VPC update — customer follow-up & artifacts
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Agent control-link disconnects during private VPC update — initial notification

Marta / ZenHealth ops team,

Quick update from our side — during the staggered private VPC control-plane update we started seeing short-lived agent control-link disconnects in two of your nodes in us-west-2. The symptom was small spikes in inference latency and a handful of 502s while agents re-established KV/cache sessions (most events were 30–90s, two were ~2 minutes).

What we immediately did:
- Scoped the blast radius: only the two worker pods in your VPC (node ids in attached trace) experienced session re-negotiation.
- Rolled a temporary throttling policy to reduce concurrent session resets while we investigate.
- Collected connection traces and runtime logs (attached: zenhealth-conn-trace-0620.log).

Preliminary hypothesis: an in-place control-plane config push interacted with the asymmetric TLS renegotiation path on the older agent binary we had running on those nodes. That caused a brief handshake failure and a local reconnect. We are continuing deeper analysis.

Immediate asks:
1) Would you be available for a 30-minute bridge today at 15:30 PT for a quick walk-through and to align on remediation timing?
2) Can we patch those two nodes tonight with a build that forces persistent session keepalives (non-disruptive, validated in our staging env)? We expect a ~12m maintenance window per node.

I recognize this is disruptive — apologies. We will send an interim customer-facing status note after our initial bridge.

Attachments: zenhealth-conn-trace-0620.log (text), mitigation-checklist.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Sr Site Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@zenhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@zenhealth.com
Date: 2028-06-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Agent control-link disconnects during private VPC update — initial notification

Diego,

Thanks for the heads up. We saw the same symptoms in our dashboards: a couple of production requests returned 502s and latency spiked for a few customers of our triage pipeline. Impact summary from our side:
- ~0.6% of inference requests for the 09:42–10:03 window returned 502
- Two batch jobs timed out and were retried (no data loss)

15:30 PT works for a bridge. For tonight's patch, we need a clear rollback plan and an expected SLO impact window communicated to our on-call. Also please confirm whether this is likely to affect any other regions or just us-west-2.

We will join the bridge with both eng and ops.

—Marta
Head of Platform Engineering
ZenHealth
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Agent control-link disconnects — traces and tactical plan

Diego / Ben,

Summary of findings from traces so far (attached in Diego's message):
- TLS handshake errors correlate with a config-apply event on the control-plane at 09:40:11.
- A subset of agents (older build: 1.7.3) use an opentransport path that occasionally drops the pre-shared session on mid-update config pushes.
- Staging replay reproduces a single reconnect event; our 1.8.x agent release has addressed the renegotiation fallback.

Tactical plan (proposed):
A) Tonight (22:00–23:00 PT): patch two affected nodes to agent 1.8.2 with keepalive enforcement. Rolling by node to avoid mass restart. Expected per-node disruption: 10–14 minutes.
B) Tomorrow morning: forced health-check sweep and KV cache validation for full fleet in us-west-2.
C) Post-deploy: collect 48h telemetry and run a targeted eval prompt set for correctness/regression.

Rollback: we can reapply the previous control-plane config and re-deploy agent 1.7.3 if there is an unexpected regression. That rollback path is tested and will be ready to execute within 20 minutes.

Ben — please confirm whether we should schedule the patch tonight (customer approved) or wait until a midnight window. Also flag any legal/procurement approvals needed if the customer requests credits.

Mina
Staff SRE
Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Agent control-link disconnects during private VPC update — status and patch plan

Marta — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming bridge attendance. Bridge invite sent for 15:30 PT (dial-in + link in calendar).

We will proceed with the patch tonight at 22:00 PT under the proposed plan A unless you prefer a later window. Quick notes for your ops team:
- We expect transient request latency for in-flight connections only; no persistent data loss.
- Regional impact: current evidence shows this is isolated to us-west-2 where the older agent binary rolled previously; we see no signals from eu-west or ap-southeast.
- Rollback plan: immediate re-deploy to 1.7.3 and reapply previous control-plane config; estimated 20m to complete.

If you confirm "patch tonight", we will send a runbook and on-call contacts.

Thanks,
Diego
Sr Site Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Post-incident summary: control-link reconnects during 2028-06-20 VPC update — draft PM & next steps

Marta / ZenHealth team,

Thank you for the bridge and for the cooperative troubleshooting over the last 48 hours. Attached is the draft post-incident summary and the production rollforward plan (zenhealth-postmortem-draft.pdf, prod-rollforward-plan.md). Below is an executive summary and action items.

Executive summary:
- Incident window: 2028-06-20T09:40:11–2028-06-20T10:04:40 PT.
- Impact: short-lived control-link disconnects on two worker nodes in us-west-2 caused ~0.6% request errors and transient latency spikes (see attached traces).
- Root cause: config-apply on the control-plane triggered TLS renegotiation on agents running build 1.7.3. The older agent's transport path could drop session state under mid-update config pushes.
- Mitigation performed: temporary throttling policy, targeted patch to agent 1.8.2 on affected nodes, full fleet KV cache sweep the next morning.

Customer-facing remediation and timeline:
- We deployed agent 1.8.2 to the two affected nodes on 2028-06-20 at 22:03 PT; nodes stabilized within 11 minutes each.
- Full fleet sweep completed 2028-06-21 08:12 PT with no residual reconnect signals.
- We will include a permanent guard in the control-plane deploy flow to prevent session renegotiation during config pushes; ETA for that change: 2028-07-05.

Open action items:
1) Redwood: finalize and publish the postmortem (attached draft) — expected publication 2028-06-24.
2) Redwood: schedule a follow-up review with your platform team to validate the fix on a representative staging cluster (proposed week of 2028-06-27).
3) ZenHealth: let us know if you would like us to calculate a customer credit for the affected window; Ben/Laura can coordinate.

Attachments: zenhealth-postmortem-draft.pdf, prod-rollforward-plan.md

If you want any edits to the draft before we publish, please reply here or flag in the linked DRIVE doc: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/teams/ops/ZenHealth/2028-06-20-postmortem-draft

Apologies again for the disruption. We appreciate the rapid collaboration.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Sr Site Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
